title: Choose the visual world
question: Re-roll recovered. Your steer: colors were too dull. Host Console and the last hand stay eliminated. The oscilloscope challenger was dropped: phosphor on black is the world you already discarded.

options.label: Device Datasheet
options.lineage: GPU / CUDA programming-guide covers and device tables
options.thesis: The landing is a device sheet: Preview as the part number, grants as rated specs, install as the first assembly note.
options.viewport: A green field owning the first screen; AKASHA OS as the part name; a gold-ruled spec table (host, NVIDIA, not bootable); Install as the only red note.
options.risk: Can look like a driver PDF if the green field is timid and the type stays gray.

raised.raise: Action red: Install is the only process-red ink. Everything else is green, gold, or paper.
Active step: install is a numbered sequence with one gold-lit step, not a lone button.
Cut blocks: sections sit as stacked plates with vivid gaps, not a gray wall of prose.
Restricted inks: three loud inks only. No gray standing in for quieter text.

options.label: Pit Board
options.lineage: racing pit boards held over the wall
options.thesis: The first viewport is a fluorescent board: HOST, NVIDIA, NOT BOOTABLE, then INSTALL as the next instruction.
options.viewport: A black wall, one yellow board filling the frame, four stacked lines, INSTALL in red at the foot.
options.risk: The most familiar high-chroma move, and the one most runs reach when asked for louder color.

options.label: Four-Color Host
options.lineage: silver-age comic page, ben-day, CMYK pulp
options.thesis: The thesis is a splash caption; grants are panels; Install is the action lettering reserved in process red.
options.viewport: A pulp splash: AKASHA OS in action type, a caption box with the honesty line, then a six-panel grant grid that is a comic page, not product cards.
options.case: Holds audience identification: everyone can read a comic page. Loses on product clarity: pulp fight energy can swallow the host-app limit.
options.risk: Reads as a joke OS if the splash is louder than the NVIDIA line.

options.label: Fold Sequence
options.lineage: orizuru crane, thirty-two folds on one vermilion sheet
options.thesis: Install is a crease sequence: one uncut sheet from flat honesty to a finished host, each step numbered in the margin.
options.viewport: A red square owning the field; step 1 gold-lit: not a bootable OS; later steps are Windows/Linux, NVIDIA, then run the script.
options.case: Holds product clarity: a numbered fold is a procedure testers can follow. Loses on audience identification: this cohort does not live in origami.
options.risk: The crane can become decoration if the sheet stops being the whole page.

options.label: Host Room
options.thesis: The host is a furnishable room; grants are objects you place; visitors see the same room.
options.viewport: An isometric room with a tiny GPU, a locked network door, and a guest ledger for feedback.
options.case: Loses both axes: testers do not identify with a decorated room, and furniture invents a scene the product does not ship.
options.kept: The surface itself is the identity, not a chrome wrapper around a hero.
options.risk: Cute, and it fabricates a room Preview does not have.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Services are cut weather-blocks stacked with blue voids between them.
options.viewport: Stacked white blocks named capkd, modeld, agentd, with blue gaps and a cut edge labeled Preview.
options.case: Loses both axes: a quarry of weather is not this cohort, and voids hide the NVIDIA requirement.
options.kept: Sections as cut plates with vivid gaps, not a continuous gray column.

options.label: Kiosk Print
options.lineage: state kiosk ephemera, three inks, no photos
options.thesis: Grant, install, and docs as everyday printed goods in one restricted ink set.
options.viewport: A kiosk grid of tickets: install, first-run, feedback, each in the same three inks.
options.case: Loses both axes: a goods grid becomes feature cards, and testers do not shop a kiosk for an OS.
options.kept: Three loud inks only. No gray for secondary type.
options.risk: The card grid you already refused, in nicer inks.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark AI-OS hero, three feature cards, a Download button, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A night hero, a feature row, a primary download.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from neighboring agent desktops by design.
